role_context: You are illustrating a square collection cover for FTP Music, an offline-first Android music app. The image will appear as a small rounded tile on Home, Search, and detail screens on a phone, so the focal motif must read clearly at thumbnail size. This is original decorative art, not a photograph of a real album sleeve and not UI chrome.
base_constraints: Square 1:1. Centered focal subject with quiet margins for a rounded crop. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, QR codes, brand marks, album titles, or typography of any kind. No celebrity likenesses, no real band or idol faces, no copyrighted mascots. No flags used as cliché national stickers; cultural mood via color, light, and abstract forms only. Keep the SAME subject motif family as other style packs for this slug so a user switching packs still recognizes the collection.
composition: Composition: single dominant centered motif occupying roughly the middle 70% of the frame; simplified background; high silhouette contrast; avoid busy full-bleed patterns that muddy at 96–128 dp tile size; leave soft margin for rounded corners; no cluttered corners; no tiny details that vanish when shrunk.
negatives: photoreal album photos, stock photo people, faces, hands with rings as focus, readable text, logos, watermarks, brand marks, UI buttons, status bars, frames-within-frames, collages of many tiny objects, low-contrast muddy brown soup, celebrity or idol likeness, copyrighted characters
daily_mix_framing: Framed as Daily Mix card art: subtle concentric orbit rings behind the motif, a gentle dawn-to-night gradient bar along the bottom edge with no text or labels, slightly brighter and more dynamic than the matching genre cover, same motif family.

anime.technique: Japanese modern cel-shaded illustration, anime key-visual polish
anime.line_and_form: clean linework, bold silhouettes, soft screen-tone gradients
anime.palette: expressive saturated color with clear accent hierarchy
anime.lighting: dramatic rim light and soft fill, cinematic anime lighting
anime.texture: smooth cel fills with light grain, no photographic noise
anime.do: music-themed props and environments without idol-like characters; keep shapes thumbnail-clear
anime.avoid_extra: realistic skin pores, idol face close-ups, cluttered manga panels

pixel48.line_and_form: chunky blocky pixels, hard edges, readable silhouette at tiny size
pixel48.lighting: flat or simple 2-step light, no soft blur
pixel48.texture: hard pixel grid, no anti-alias blur, no photographic grain
pixel48.do: design as if native 48 by 48 then scaled up; maximize silhouette clarity
pixel48.avoid_extra: smooth gradients, photorealism, fine hair detail, anti-aliased edges
